<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="blueBg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#143CC9"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#071B70"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="bannerOne" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#143CC9"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000000"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="bannerTwo" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#000000"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#143CC9"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="4" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".28"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="url(#blueBg)"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="30" fill="#000000" opacity=".22"/>

  <line x1="331" y1="19" x2="331" y2="14" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="336" y1="19" x2="336" y2="11" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="341" y1="19" x2="341" y2="8" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>

  <rect x="367" y="11" width="13" height="7" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="385" y="12" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="16" y="42" width="34" height="34" rx="17" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>
  <polyline points="36,51 27,59 36,67" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="67" y="61" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="23" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Promotions</text>
  <text x="67" y="77" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".78">Exclusive cinema offers for you</text>

  <!-- Content panel -->
  <rect x="0" y="94" width="390" height="680" rx="22" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="20" y="123" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Featured offers</text>
  <text x="370" y="123" text-anchor="end" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#143CC9">2 available</text>

  <!-- Offer one shadow and banner -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="18" y="139" width="354" height="220" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <rect x="18" y="139" width="354" height="106" rx="13" fill="url(#bannerOne)"/>
  <circle cx="326" cy="164" r="27" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".12"/>
  <circle cx="350" cy="213" r="47" fill="#143CC9" opacity=".42"/>
  <polygon points="18,224 95,174 160,245 18,245" fill="#143CC9" opacity=".62"/>
  <polygon points="105,245 183,178 255,245" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".11"/>
  <path d="M235 139 L354 139 L354 188 C318 175 282 166 235 139 Z" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".08"/>
  <path d="M18 204 C70 181 104 183 151 207 C192 228 237 230 276 209" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" opacity=".2"/>
  <path d="M270 245 C295 219 321 208 372 211 L372 245 Z" fill="#000000" opacity=".22"/>
  <text x="34" y="174" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">WEEKEND SPECIAL</text>
  <text x="34" y="204" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="25" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">2 FOR 1</text>
  <text x="34" y="226" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Movie tickets every Saturday</text>

  <text x="32" y="271" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Two tickets, one great price</text>
  <text x="32" y="291" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#747474">Save on standard admission for your next movie night.</text>
  <rect x="32" y="310" width="86" height="25" rx="13" fill="#143CC9"/>
  <text x="75" y="327" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">SAVE $12.00</text>
  <text x="350" y="327" text-anchor="end" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#747474">Valid until Jun 30</text>

  <!-- Offer two -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="18" y="378" width="354" height="220" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <rect x="18" y="378" width="354" height="106" rx="13" fill="url(#bannerTwo)"/>
  <circle cx="300" cy="404" r="22" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".12"/>
  <circle cx="330" cy="438" r="38" fill="#143CC9" opacity=".48"/>
  <polygon points="18,477 77,425 148,484 18,484" fill="#143CC9" opacity=".64"/>
  <polygon points="155,484 225,414 300,484" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".12"/>
  <path d="M18 407 C75 430 115 430 163 402 C205 377 251 382 303 405" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" opacity=".2"/>
  <path d="M238 378 L372 378 L372 425 C331 411 282 401 238 378 Z" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".08"/>
  <text x="34" y="413" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">MEMBER PERK</text>
  <text x="34" y="443" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">FREE POPCORN</text>
  <text x="34" y="466" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">With any premium ticket</text>

  <text x="32" y="510" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">A little extra for the big screen</text>
  <text x="32" y="530" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#747474">Enjoy a complimentary medium popcorn with your booking.</text>
  <rect x="32" y="549" width="100" height="25" rx="13" fill="#143CC9"/>
  <text x="82" y="566" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">FREE TREAT</text>
  <text x="350" y="566" text-anchor="end" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#747474">Valid until Jul 15</text>

  <!-- Terms section -->
  <line x1="20" y1="620" x2="370" y2="620" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="20" y="648" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Terms & conditions</text>
  <circle cx="28" cy="669" r="2" fill="#143CC9"/>
  <text x="38" y="673" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#747474">Offers can be redeemed once per transaction.</text>
  <circle cx="28" cy="691" r="2" fill="#143CC9"/>
  <text x="38" y="695" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#747474">Cannot be combined with other promotions.</text>
  <circle cx="28" cy="713" r="2" fill="#143CC9"/>
  <text x="38" y="717" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#747474">Valid at participating theatres; blackout dates apply.</text>
  <text x="20" y="746" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#143CC9">Promotion details may change without notice.</text>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="774" width="390" height="70" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="774" x2="390" y2="774" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="29,800 39,791 49,800 49,811 42,811 42,804 36,804 36,811 29,811" fill="none" stroke="#747474" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="39" y="830" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#747474">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="117" cy="801" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#747474" stroke-width="1.7"/>

    <text x="117" y="830" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#747474">Movies</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="175" y="793" width="20" height="16" rx="3" fill="#143CC9"/>
    <polygon points="181,809 186,814 190,809" fill="#143CC9"/>
    <circle cx="181" cy="801" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

    <text x="185" y="830" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#143CC9">Offers</text>
  </g>

    <text x="263" y="830" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#747474">Profile</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="342" cy="801" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#747474" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="342" y1="795" x2="342" y2="807" stroke="#747474" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="336" y1="801" x2="348" y2="801" stroke="#747474" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="342" y="830" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#747474">Help</text>
  </g>
</svg>
